name: pooled-onset-confirmatory
title: Confirmatory pooled-vs-persistence onset forecasting under publication interruptions
description: Pre-registered confirmatory test of whether a pooled (non-partitioned) global model beats stale-label persistence and stronger simple baselines on onset (non-crisis-at-origin) keys under simulated 1-2 cycle CS outages, evaluated on a genuinely held-out window (e.g. 2026-02 CS); planning and grilling first, spec on disk before execution; no trellis-audit registration.
creator: swl007007
